skill: AS2-W four-wheel rolling (independent skill; stepping/stairs/stand-up excluded)
summary: best Isaac candidate so far: seed 7393 scores 7/11 and BOTH arcs pass (the control fails arc_left), but all four pure turns fail on both simulators, so there is still no accepted weight

deployment_model.note: this ONNX is the CONTROL weight's export, kept for interface verification; it does NOT correspond to the selected armD checkpoint
deployment_model.armD_onnx_export: not_run - exporting armD requires the export script plus the armD checkpoint; the export path itself is verified byte-exact

armD_10k_line.reason: the 6600 checkpoint scores 6/11 with arc_right collapsing to 0.17, below the 1k checkpoint

action.name: action
action.layout: 12 leg axes (position, scale 0.35, offset DEF) then 4 wheel axes (velocity, scale 16)

mjcf.portability: relative meshdir; loads from a clean git clone

mujoco_selected_weight.note: the MuJoCo matrix exists for the CONTROL weight (7/11) but not for armD

C1_C8.C4_output_to_control: partial - the action chain is delivered, but the acceptance script's tau_max/ff_max read 0 on every case, so the torque-headroom item is not_measured

caveats: the shipped policy.onnx belongs to the CONTROL weight, not to the selected armD checkpoint - the armD ONNX export was not run
no accepted weight exists: all four pure turns fail on both simulators
the two simulators fail pure turns in OPPOSITE directions (Isaac undershoots 0.10-0.31, MuJoCo overshoots 1.41-1.56); the mechanism is not yet located
the Isaac implicit-drive saturation rate is not_measured - applied_torque is a limit-clipped telemetry estimate, not the solver's drive force
the long-turn dwell was never implemented: AS2W_AB_TURN_DWELL_* are printed but never read, so armB/armC/armD are mixture-only experiments
single-leg lift is geometrically infeasible in the current stance: IK reaches 0.25-1.73 mm of a 10 mm target and the measured wheel height goes negative
the posture bias was rejected: MuJoCo improved but Isaac zero-command drift worsened 65-350x
R2 is partial: the MuJoCo formal matrix for the selected weight is not_run
no hardware evidence of any kind
